import math

# December 1938
working_1938 = 2449
total_1938 = 3083
ratio_1938 = working_1938 / total_1938

# December 1940
working_1940 = 1188
total_1940 = 1928
ratio_1940 = working_1940 / total_1940

print(f"December 1938 ratio (working/total): {ratio_1938}")
print(f"December 1940 ratio (working/total): {ratio_1940}")

# Geometric annual rate of change over 2 years (Dec 1938 to Dec 1940)
# Formula: (ratio_1940 / ratio_1938)^(1/2) - 1
growth_factor = ratio_1940 / ratio_1938
geometric_rate = math.pow(growth_factor, 1/2) - 1

print(f"\nGrowth factor over 2 years: {growth_factor}")
print(f"Geometric annual rate of change: {geometric_rate}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(geometric_rate, 3)}")
EOF
